name: Werewolf Pack Leader
oracle_text:
Pack tactics — Whenever this creature attacks, if you attacked with creatures with total power 6 or greater this combat, draw a card.
{3}{G}: Until end of turn, this creature has base power and toughness 5/3, gains trample, and isn't a Human.
blocked_sentences: {3}{G}: Until end of turn, this creature has base power and toughness 5/3, gains trample, and isn't a Human.

needs.what: an op removing one creature type from a permanent until end of turn (layer 4), leaving its other types and subtypes untouched -- "isn't a Human"
needs.why_existing_wont_do: add_subtype only adds; animate's subtypes add, and animate with exact replaces every subtype, so a Werewolf that had also gained other types would lose them too. The pack tactics line is expressible with attack_power_this_combat, but a partial answer is not allowed
